name: Bru
source:
He’s a thirty-something ex-con. He lives in a bad neighborhood and has led a rough life, going in and out prison for small robberies and break-ins. He’s an open-minded and easy-going person, who loves the little pleasures in life. He likes alcohol and joking around.

[From Casting Call]
